_note: Demo transcript for test/glass-proof.mjs. The proof shifts it to end a minute ago and serves it as the live meeting (maverick.live) through an in-memory localStorage shim, so real history and settings are never read or written. at = seconds from the start. Answer and Ask read the two minutes before the last line, so the lines from 652 s on carry what the demo questions need.
title: Weekly sync, Q3 launch review

lines.text: Okay, let's start. Omar is sharing the Q3 launch review.
Revenue is up fourteen percent against plan, mostly from the new onboarding flow.
And churn fell to 2.1 percent after the onboarding change. That is the lowest this year.
I still need two days to finish the budget. I will send it by Friday.
The team wants to move the launch to Thursday. Does anyone see a problem with that?
Support is the part I'm worried about. Nobody owns it yet.
Pricing tiers are still open. We have three options and no decision.
The EU rollout depends on the legal review, which lands next week.
Engineering is ready for Thursday if QA signs off on Wednesday.
I can own support for the first two weeks, then we hand it to Lina's team.
Let me be clear: no launch spend goes out until the budget is signed on Friday.
Fine. So Thursday for the launch, the budget on Friday, and spend waits for the budget.
For [unclear] EU pricing, we should match the US tiers at first.
Next review in two weeks, same time.
Before we wrap up: when can we actually launch? I want a firm date I can give the board.
